user.title: Add Somfy Bluetooth motor
user.description: Enter the motor name. A Bluetooth address and printed PIN are optional.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Add Somfy Bluetooth motor
bluetooth_confirm.description: Home Assistant found a Somfy motor nearby. Name it and enter the 6-character PIN printed on the motor.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Somfy motor
reconfigure.description: Confirm or correct the motor name and Bluetooth address. Enter a new printed PIN only when it needs to change; leave PIN blank to keep the current value.

error.already_configured: That motor name or Bluetooth address is already assigned to another entry.

read_config.name: Read motor config
read_config.description: Read the motor configuration file (speed, ramps) over Bluetooth. Changes nothing on the motor.

motor.name: Motor
motor.description: Motor name, as in the blind selector.

write_config.name: Write motor config
write_config.description: Write one motor setting, then read it back. Requires a read of the same motor in the last 15 minutes that includes the setting.

motor.name: Motor
motor.description: Motor name, as in the blind selector.

value.name: Value
value.description: New value, from the values the read reported.
